title: Train the team on Godot 4 game development (researcher skill)
description: Spawn the researcher to investigate Godot 4.x (4.6.3) 2D game-development best practices for Mage Rage and capture them as a reusable Agent Skill under .claude/skills/ so the developer/reviewer are "trained" on the stack cheaply. Focus on the architecture the GDD mandates: node-based Finite State Machine for movement, custom Resource (SpellData) data-driven design, collision Layers/Masks, TileMapLayer + terrains/autotiling, CharacterBody2D 2D movement, signals/scene composition/autoloads, and headless GUT unit testing. Ground all guidance in official Godot 4 docs and verify against Godot 4.6. Use the agentic-framework tech-training-template as the skill scaffold; the frontmatter description must state WHEN to load the skill (any Godot/GDScript/.tscn/.tres/.gd work). Source canon: docs/GDD.md, docs/LORE-BIBLE.md, .claude/agents/project-context.md.
acceptance_criteria: A new Agent Skill exists under .claude/skills/<godot-stack-name>/SKILL.md with valid frontmatter (name + WHEN-to-load description).

Skill covers, with GDScript code snippets and pitfalls: node-based FSM for movement states, SpellData custom Resource pattern, collision Layers/Masks scheme, TileMapLayer autotiling/terrains, CharacterBody2D movement, signals/autoloads/scene composition.
Skill documents headless test workflow with GUT, including the exact C:\Godot console-binary command to run tests.
All non-obvious claims cite official Godot 4 documentation (docs.godotengine.org) and are valid for Godot 4.6.
Guidance is consistent with docs/GDD.md (no contradictions) and references the canon docs where relevant.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Researcher delivered skill at .claude/skills/godot-game-dev/ (SKILL.md + references/fsm-states.md + references/gut-testing.md). Covers node FSM, SpellData Resource, collision layers/masks, CharacterBody2D movement, TileMapLayer, project hygiene, headless GUT (exact console-binary command). All claims cited to official Godot 4 docs, verified for 4.6. Orchestrator fixed one mismatched FSM citation (was pointing at scene_unique_nodes). Caveat to revisit: confirm exact GUT addon version once addons/gut/ is installed. AC met.
